description: Focused Phase 2E ridge check around the Phase 2D 1h ATR-width candidate. Goal: find a symmetric long/short PF EMA200-bounce-like strategy before adding blockers or exit management.
notes: Base controls are kept because base w11/r12 remains the cleanest symmetric local bounce reference.
Primary rail remains 2.15. Rail 2.35 is only an upper semantic comparator.
No 2.45 transition rail in this phase: avoid selecting trend-capture as the main candidate.
No RSI blocker, ADX, BE/lock, runtime exits, partial TP, trailing, HTF context, or asymmetric rails.
Main selection must prioritize long/short PF symmetry, trade count, and visible EMA200 bounce semantics over raw PnL.

reject_as_main_if: PnL gain appears to come from broad trend capture rather than EMA200 bounce
drawdown improves only by losing too many trades
